excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<nicoserranop> 0. Run it in Ubuntu (if you use Windows try WSL) 
1. Install Rust (https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials/install-rust-on-ubuntu-linux) 
2. Install SQLite (https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials/how-to-install-and-use-sqlite-on-ubuntu-20-04) 
3. Clone the repo (https://github.com/ethereum/kzg-ceremony-sequencer) 
4. Create the local db running `sqlite3 sequencer.db` and `sqlx database create`
5. Create SIWE credentials by sending a POST request to https://oidc.signinwithethereum.org/register with body 
{ 
    "redirect_uris": [ 
        "http://localhost:3000/auth/callback/eth"
        ] 
} 
 . Copy id and secret 
6. Create a Github OAuth app here https://github.com/settings/developers and get id and secret 
7. Set the following env variables 
export GH_CLIENT_SECRET=XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX 
export GH_CLIENT_ID=XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX 
export ETH_RPC_URL=YOU_CAN_USE_YOUR_INFURA_URL_HERE 
export ETH_CLIENT_SECRET=XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX 
export ETH_CLIENT_ID=XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX 
export DATABASE_URL=sqlite:sequencer.db 
export ETH_REDIRECT_URL=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback/eth 
export GH_REDIRECT_URL=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback/github 
 
# This is for testing/development only 
export ETH_MIN_NONCE=0 
export MULTI_CONTRIBUTION=true 
 
8. Run the sequencer with cargo run -- -vvv
